content.title: Tactile City Chapters | One Adult Route, Sensory Encounters, Keepsake Closure
content.summary: Carry one identity-locked adult through tactile travel chapters whose small encounters remain connected by a plausible route and a closing keepsake.

quick_start.input_format: One identity-locked adult carries the full route. + Each chapter begins with one tactile interaction. + Handheld perspective remains socially close. + Locations progress along one plausible journey. + A small encountered object becomes the closing keepsake.
quick_start.recommended_input: Follow one adult ceramic student beginning on a workshop balcony with a handheld camera. A vendor hands over one warm paper cup and the student tastes it while continuing the route. Inside the studio, a companion ties the recovered ribbon around a finished cup handle and the student turns back smiling.

usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Carry one identity-locked adult through tactile travel chapters whose small encounters remain connected by a plausible route and a closing keepsake.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
